## Analytics API (FastAPI)

Root ASGI app mounting the b2b_dashboard tenant at /api/v1/analytics and b2b_learner_records at /api/v1/learner-records. Owns the shared aiomysql StarRocks pool, refreshes its Vault-issued StarRocks credentials at 80% of the lease, and exposes /health/{startup,readiness,liveness}/ plus per-tenant /health/readiness/{tenant}/. Stateless apart from in-process TTL caches (org-manager check 60s, MV freshness, JWKS 1h).

<div class="c4-box" data-c4-svg="../_diagrams/component-analytics-api.svg"></div>

| Component | Technology | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **b2b_dashboard tenant** | FastAPI sub-app (/api/v1/analytics) | Org and contract aggregates under a k-anonymity floor (default 5), a consent-gated learner-progress view (fails open in QA and Production until a consent field exists), and the MIT-admin contract-health view. Gates every org route on X-Userinfo org membership plus a MITx Online manager check, and contract routes on contract ownership. |
| **b2b_learner_records tenant** | FastAPI sub-app (/api/v1/learner-records) | Identifiable learner, enrollment and course records for partner integrations. Verifies the bearer JWT itself (RS256, issuer, audience, token class, lifetime), requires learner-records:read and the path org in learner_records_organizations, and ignores X-Userinfo. |
| **Shared StarRocks access** | aiomysql pool + query chokepoint | One connection pool for every tenant, schema identifiers validated before splicing, per-statement query_timeout, and the anonymization chokepoint (fetch_and_suppress) that applies each model's CohortPolicy. |
| **Observability & health** | structlog, OpenTelemetry SDK, sentry-sdk | JSON logs with trace/pod fields, one access-log line per request on the root app, OTLP/HTTP trace export, Sentry errors, and tiered K8s probes. |
